title: ProviderRegistration
description: Metadata for one judgement producer, so both harnesses can consume the same provider through the same shape (5.7 R40 scenario 5). It declares who provides what and what they need; it never carries a judgement, which stays in the engine and the reviewers. NOTE ON SOURCE OF TRUTH: the field constraints are duplicated from `src/provider-registration.ts`, which is the definition; this file mirrors it. METHOD-LEVEL UNIQUENESS IS ENFORCED BY ZOD ONLY: `uniqueItems` compares whole objects, so two methods with the same name but different `requires` pass this schema and are refused by `ProviderRegistrationSchema`. The registry semantics (refusing to overwrite an id, no default provider, no fuzzy resolve) are functions in the validator, not schema features.
